historical_references.reference: Jaser ibn Abdul-Malik was a prominent Umayyad general and governor during the reign of his uncle, Caliph Al-Walid I. He is best known for his campaigns against the Byzantines, particularly the Battle of Akroinon in 740 AD which resulted in a significant victory for the Muslims.

Jaser ibn Mundir was a Berber military leader who ruled the Maghreb under the Rashidun Caliphate in the late 7th century. He is known for his rebellion against Caliph Al-Walid I, which was motivated by his desire to gain more autonomy for the Maghreb and to put an end to Arab domination.
